articles.title: Crypto payments barely register among euro area merchants, ECB finds
articles.snippet: Crypto acceptance was just 0.2% online and remained below 1% at physical points of sale, while mobile payments gained ground.

articles.title: Ethereum Foundation pivots away from Poseidon in post-quantum plan
articles.snippet: Advances in compact proofs have erased Poseidon’s previous performance advantage, according to researcher Justin Drake.
